latest_release.name: 🛠 Albumentations 2.0.8 Release Notes
latest_release.body:
**Want to stay in the loop?**  
Get updates on new features, documentation changes, and tools like the UI explorer by subscribing to our mailing list:  
👉 [https://albumentations.ai/subscribe/](https://albumentations.ai/subscribe/)  
*You can unsubscribe anytime.*

---
## 💖 Support Our Work

1. **Help Us Grow** – Found Albumentations useful? [Become a sponsor](https://albumentations.ai/support/) to support ongoing development.
2. **Show Your Support** – A ⭐ on [GitHub](https://github.com/albumentations-team/albumentations) helps others discover us.
3. **Join the Community** – Report issues or suggest improvements via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/albumentations-team/albumentations/issues) or join discussions on [Discord](https://discord.gg/AmMnDBdzYs).

## Improvements
### Added `area_for_downscale` to [RandomResizedCrop](https://explore.albumentations.ai/transform/RandomResizedCrop) and [RandomSizedCrop](https://explore.albumentations.ai/transform/RandomSizedCrop)

parameter may have value:
- `image`
- `image_mask`
- None

When enabled will use interpolation that was passed to the transform for upscale, but `cv2.INTER_AREA` for downscale, as for downscale `INTER_AREA` generates the least amount of artifacts.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a685217b-2c80-44b8-a1f0-347fd065b95b)

## Speedups
Vectorized application to videos and volume in

- [CoarseDropout](https://explore.albumentations.ai/transform/CoarseDropout), [Erasing](https://explore.albumentations.ai/transform/Erasing) and [ConstrainedCoarseDropout](https://explore.albumentations.ai/transform/ConstrainedCoarseDropout). (5.2x speedup) @huydoanx172 
- [Pad](https://explore.albumentations.ai/transform/Pad), [PadIfNeeded](https://explore.albumentations.ai/transform/PadIfNeeded). (3.5x speedup) by @martinsbruveris 

When applied to videos [Albumentations](https://albumentations.ai/) on 1 CPU core is still, slower than torchvision on GTX 4090, ([Benchmark on videos](https://albumentations.ai/docs/benchmarks/video-benchmarks/)). But with such pull requests, the gap. hopefully, will get smaller.


## Bugfixes
- Fixed bug in [MotionBlur](https://explore.albumentations.ai/transform/MotionBlur), direction argument was not used.
- Bugfix in saving / loading piplines to huggingface hub. Now it works in windows as well.
